items.a: IFA Berlin takes place from 4 to 8 September 2026 at Messe Berlin, Messedamm 22.

items.q: What are the IFA 2026 hours for private visitors?
items.a: Private visitors can enter from 12:00 to 18:00 on Friday 4 September, and from 10:00 to 18:00 on Saturday to Tuesday. Trade visitors have different access times.

items.q: Does an IFA ticket include Berlin public transport?
items.a: No. The official IFA FAQ says admission tickets and exhibitor passes do not include U-Bahn, S-Bahn, bus or tram travel.

items.q: Which stations are useful for Messe Berlin?
items.a: IFA lists Messe Nord/ICC, Charlottenburg, Kaiserdamm and Theodor-Heuss-Platz as useful approaches. Check your exact entrance and a live route on the day.

items.q: What should I do after IFA closes?
items.a: Choose one realistic area rather than crossing the whole city. Charlottenburg suits a low-energy evening, while Kulturforum/Potsdamer Platz or Mitte work when you still have time and energy.
